parse_hint: Second hotfix to the live 5.0.16 patch, officially named 5.0.16b (released 2026-07-16); it follows the earlier 2026-06-30 hotfix, so parse only what THIS article states. Stated intent: 'calibrating both Protoss and Terran to help deal with Zerg' - there are NO Zerg balance changes in this patch. Entity mappings: 'Colossus damage increased from 10(+5 vs Light) to 12(+3 vs Light)' -> protoss-colossus (BUFF: damage vs Light is unchanged at 15 total, but damage vs everything else rises from 10 to 12); 'Adept damage modifier per attack upgrade increased from 1(+1 vs Light) to 2(+2 vs Light)' -> protoss-adept (buff); 'Gateway unit train time reduction bonus from researching Warp Gate increased from 40% to 50%' -> protoss-gateway (buff); 'Gateway/Warpgate transformation duration reduced to 4s (previously 7s and 5s)' -> protoss-gateway (buff); 'Disruptor phantom weapon range decreased from 11.35 to 7' -> protoss-disruptor (nerf); 'Command Center cost reduced from 400 to 300 minerals' -> terran-command_center (buff); 'Planetary Fortress cost increased from 150/150 to 250/150' -> terran-planetary_fortress (nerf); 'Ghost Supply reduced from 3 to 2' -> terran-ghost (buff). Also INCLUDE these gameplay-relevant items from 'Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Updates' (exclude the rest): 'Reverted spawned Hallucinations inheriting their caster's order queue' -> protoss-sentry (nerf: reverts a control improvement shipped in 5.0.16); 'Fixed an issue in Team games where Cyclones could fail to deal damage to units detected by an ally' -> terran-cyclone (buff); the Warpgate/Gateway selection changes ('Warpgates now have selection subgroup priority over Gateways', 'Warpgates and Gateways are now considered distinct units when issuing select all commands', 'Gateways and Warpgates can now be issued orders to transform regardless of which is the primary subgroup selection') -> protoss-gateway (buff, macro quality of life). EXCLUDE the purely cosmetic/non-entity items: the 'Load Nearby Transport ability reverted' line, the Gateway train visuals graphics-setting fix, the allied-structures worker fix, and the colorblind selection radius change.

Hotfix to the live 5.0.16 patch (released 2026-06-30). Capture every change from the Economy, Zerg, Terran, and Protoss sections. Entity mappings: 'Default Geyser reduced from 2,500 to 2,000' -> neutral-vespene_geyser (nerf); 'Larva Rate increased from 9.5 to 9.9' -> zerg-hatchery (this is a NERF: the spawn interval got longer, so larva spawn slower); 'Widow Mine Lock on time' -> terran-widow_mine (buff); 'Reaper build time' -> terran-reaper (nerf); 'Bile no longer instantly destroys force fields, instead it destroys 50% of its duration' -> zerg-ravager (nerf; Corrosive Bile is the Ravager's ability - it is listed under Protoss only because it makes Force Fields more durable); 'Adept Pre-warpgate buildtime' -> protoss-adept (nerf); 'High Templar & Dark Templar Pre-warpgate Build time decreased from 43 to 40' -> TWO separate buff changes: protoss-high_templar and protoss-dark_templar; Mothership shields 350->200 and health 350->400 -> protoss-mothership (net nerf: total durability drops from 700 to 600). Also INCLUDE from Bug Fixes: 'Reverted Queen inject shuffle adjustment' -> zerg-queen (nerf: reverts the inject re-issuing improvement shipped in 5.0.16).

This is the FINAL LIVE release of 5.0.16 (2026-06-22); it supersedes the earlier PTR iterations, so parse only what this article states. Entity mappings: 'Starting workers reduced from 12 to 8' -> one nerf each for terran-scv, zerg-drone, protoss-probe; Mineral patch resource counts -> neutral-mineral_field; Vespene Geyser resource counts and Rich Vespene harvest value -> neutral-vespene_geyser; 'Hatchery, Lair and Hive' supplies and cost changes -> separate changes for zerg-hatchery, zerg-lair, zerg-hive; Creep spread/recede rate and 'Larva Periodic spawn rate' -> zerg-hatchery; Carapace Upgrades level costs -> zerg-evolution_chamber; 'Subgroup Priority' order update -> terran-medivac (mixed); Steady Targeting changes -> terran-ghost; Warpgate Research boost, 'Transform to Warpgate' cost, and Warp-in Time -> protoss-gateway; 'Warpgate Cooldown Values' and 'Post-Warpgate Production Time Values' -> per-unit changes on protoss-zealot, protoss-adept, protoss-stalker, protoss-sentry, protoss-high_templar, protoss-dark_templar; 'Shield Battery starts with 75 energy upon completion' -> protoss-shield_battery (buff). Also INCLUDE these gameplay-relevant items from the 'Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Updates' section (exclude the rest): the Queen inject improvement ('Improved an issue where injecting Queens shuffle...') -> zerg-queen (buff; note: this gets reverted in the 5.0.16 hotfix); 'Xel'naga towers can now be selected through the Fog of War...' -> neutral-xelnaga_tower (buff); 'Mule Repair is now set to auto-cast by default' -> terran-orbital_command (buff).
INCLUDE the Broodling attack speed fix from Bug Fixes section ('Fixed an issue with Broodlings' attack speed') as a buff to zerg-brood_lord. This was a significant gameplay fix.

INCLUDE the Broodling launch fix from Bug Fixes section ('Fixed an issue where Broodlings could greatly delay launching or fail to launch toward their target, depending on their position relative to the broodlord') as a buff to zerg-brood_lord. This bugfix massively improved Brood Lord combat effectiveness - community considers it a huge buff.
EXCLUDE the Vespene Geyser footprint change. This is NOT a balance change - it's a compensatory fix to maintain existing worker-geyser interactions after the worker inner radius was changed.
Mag-Field Launchers removal is a BUFF: the +2 range it gave is now in the base stats (range 4→6 in the same patch). EXCLUDE subgroup priority changes — UI ordering, not balance.
The 'Rocks now have 0 armor' change is in Co-op Missions section. Do NOT include it - Co-op only, not Versus.
